decisions.reason: As a relatively non-core consumer product in a firm with many more promising industrial technology options, its option value appears weaker than the commercialization effort and managerial attention it would continue to require.

Because these modular waste-to-energy extensions fit the established business and likely have comparatively low carrying costs as add-ons to existing platforms, it is worth keeping the option open while demand develops.
As a flagship waste-oil-to-energy plant squarely aligned with the firm's strategic direction, the product retains strong option value despite uncertainty and is likely to keep receiving support.
This plastic-waste-to-fuel plant is close to the core offer and presented as a strategic focus, so management is likely to preserve it as a high-upside option rather than exit now.
